positions.title: User Tester
positions.description: Analyzed Client’s UI’s from the perspective of a potential user. Delivered oral walk through of products, followed by critiques and suggestions on how to improve the UX.

projects.title: AI learns to play Snake
projects.description: AI learns to play Snake using deep learning with neural networks and a genetic algorithm.  Includes a dashboard with controls for the evolutionary process, as well as data visualizations for the average fitness of each generation. Includes a playable version of Snake. Built with TensorFlow.js and p5.js.

projects.title: Flux
projects.description: Voice controlled smart DJ for Spotify, simply ask or type any request and Flux will play a song on any active Spotify device. Built with wit.ai, AngularJS, Express.js, Node.js, and powered by the Spotify API.
